Hi all —

Thanks for the clear ask list, Priya. I’ve attached a short patterns doc (redwood-vpc-patterns.pdf) and included inline answers below. We'll expand these on the deep-dive with diagrams and configuration snippets.

Summary answers (high-level):

1) Does PII leave the customer VPC by default? - For Redwood Private deployed in your VPC (customer-controlled), model inference traffic stays within your subnets. By default we do not route input prompts to Redwood-hosted telemetry endpoints. Any metrics/telemetry are opt-in and can be disabled. KV/prefix caches can be configured to use customer-managed storage (Redis or Memcached within the VPC) or a customer-owned S3 bucket.

2) Retention & key management: - Logs: We can stream request/response audit events to a customer-controlled S3 bucket or to an S3-compatible archive in your environment. Retention and immutability can be enforced with S3 object lock + Glacier Deep Archive lifecycle rules; we provide templates for the lifecycle policy.
- Keys: For encryption at rest for caches and artifacts, customer-managed KMS is supported. HSM integrations require an addendum and a short POA to enable.

3) Logging & audit format: - Each inference event can include: timestamp (ISO8601), request_id, caller_id (OIDC subject), model_id/version, input_hash (SHA256), output_hash, destination_subnet. We support exporting logs as newline-delimited JSON and can sign or checksum files on write for tamper-evidence.

4) Egress & network patterns: - Deny-by-default egress is supported. Our recommended pattern: (a) private subnets where model executors reside; (b) NAT-less egress: only allow outbound to explicit IP ranges (monitoring/updates) via egress firewall; (c) optional VPC endpoint to your S3 archive for logs. See attached redwood-vpc-patterns.pdf for diagrams (co-located VPC, cross-account role patterns, and on-prem air-gapped).

5) Air-gapped / on-prem: - We have an on-prem package that runs as a containerized runtime with an operator for lifecycle. In air-gapped mode, updates are delivered via signed artifact bundles and manual operator apply. Support SLA for air-gapped installs is a separate entitlement; we’ll need to confirm with engineering on patch turnaround but we support emergency hotfix processes.

Open items that will likely require engineering/legal review:
- 7-year immutable audit retention contract language (we can support the technical implementation, but contract/legal may need to accept liability wording).
- HSM integration timeline and any certification requirements.
- Any custom telemetry scrubbing (if you want certain fields redacted before logs are written) — we can implement at the request level but it is a project.

I’ll bring a sample configuration and a brief runbook to the call. Proposed time: Thu, 14 Nov 2025 10:00am PT — Karthik, Priya — does that work?
